label: What a dataset contains
subgoals: Identify the early-stage inputs a dataset provides
Identify the tool that computed each label
Match the input representation to the model family

label: How splits mislead
subgoals: Check whether any design appears in both train and test
Count distinct designs rather than samples
Record the tool, version and node that produced the labels

label: Comparable results
subgoals: Fix the split and the metric before comparing papers
Locate the flow scripts that regenerate the labels
Ask for downstream flow results as well as prediction error
